title: PurePath 语义：不折叠 `..`、`/` 运算符拼接与 parts 结构
expected_output:
=== POSIX 纯路径：不做规范化 ===
str        = /a/b/../c
parts      = ('/', 'a', 'b', '..', 'c')
name/parent= c / /a/b/..
suffixes   = ['.tar', '.gz']
with_suffix= a.txt

=== / 运算符拼接（不是字符串相加）===
base / 'conf' / 'app.json' = /srv/app/conf/app.json
字符串相加的陷阱           = /srv/appconf/app.json

=== Windows 纯路径：分隔符自动归一 ===
str    = C:\x\..\y\z.txt
parts  = ('C:\\', 'x', '..', 'y', 'z.txt')
drive  = 'C:' | anchor = 'C:\\'
转 POSIX: C:\x\..\y\z.txt

=== 结论 ===
PurePath 只做语法处理: '..' 保留在 parts 中, 需要折叠必须显式 resolve() 或 normpath
code:
from pathlib import PurePosixPath, PureWindowsPath

print("=== POSIX 纯路径：不做规范化 ===")
p = PurePosixPath('/a/b/../c')
print("str        =", p)
print("parts      =", p.parts)
print("name/parent=", p.name, "/", p.parent)
print("suffixes   =", PurePosixPath('archive.tar.gz').suffixes)
print("with_suffix=", PurePosixPath('a.log').with_suffix('.txt'))

print()
print("=== / 运算符拼接（不是字符串相加）===")
base = PurePosixPath('/srv/app')
print("base / 'conf' / 'app.json' =", base / 'conf' / 'app.json')
print("字符串相加的陷阱           =", '/srv/app' + 'conf/app.json')

print()
print("=== Windows 纯路径：分隔符自动归一 ===")
w = PureWindowsPath('C:/x/../y/z.txt')
print("str    =", w)
print("parts  =", w.parts)
print("drive  =", repr(w.drive), "| anchor =", repr(w.anchor))
print("转 POSIX:", PurePosixPath(str(w)))

print()
print("=== 结论 ===")
print("PurePath 只做语法处理: '..' 保留在 parts 中, 需要折叠必须显式 resolve() 或 normpath")
